newsitem.title: USA: Nextel unveils pricing by the second.
newsitem.headline: Nextel unveils pricing by the second.

text.p: Nextel Communications Inc said Monday it would offer its cellular customers a new pricing system that rounded calls up to the second, after the first minute of use, rather than the minute.
Nextel also said it would offer its PowerFone telephone, manufactured by Motorola Inc, at the reduced price of $199.00.

The PowerFone, previously available for $399.00, is available in six markets -- Chicago, Boston, Detroit, Denver, Atlanta and Las Vegas -- where Nextel introduced its enhanced iDEN technology last year.

"As our network expands, we have also eliminated roaming charges, simplified our pricing and offered a competitive pricing promotion for the PowerFone," said Dan Akerson, chairman and chief executive of Nextel.
The company said its network and pricing strategy will be promoted through a $30 million national multimedia advertising campaign.
Nextel said its all-digital wireless network covers more than 200 cities.
